metadata.title: 상용 LLM 업체별 전력·GPU·토큰 생성량 시뮬레이션
metadata.scope: Commercial LLM model owners only; hosting providers excluded from core rows.

formula_assumptions.category: Capacity definition - contracted or attributed ceiling
formula_assumptions.formula: contracted_power_gw = announced/committed capacity where sourced; otherwise explicitly modeled capacity envelope
formula_assumptions.meaning_kr: `contracted_power_gw`는 업체별 동일한 disclosure 수준의 fact가 아닙니다. OpenAI/Anthropic처럼 공개 capacity anchor가 있는 경우 상한 anchor이며, 미공개 업체는 model-owner serving capacity envelope scenario입니다.
계약/귀속 capacity 중 실제 energization, 냉각·네트워크 readiness, accelerator 배치를 통과한 몫만 토큰 산식에 진입합니다. 기존 active_power_gw 표기는 operational_power_gw와 같은 의미로 유지합니다.

formula_assumptions.formula: inference_tokens_per_day = generated output token equivalent, not input+output processed tokens
formula_assumptions.meaning_kr: 임원 보고의 headline token은 사용자가 받는 생성 output token 기준으로 해석합니다. InferenceX의 total throughput과 비교할 때는 output_tput/output_tok_s_mw를 우선 대조합니다.
계약/계획 전력이 아니라 실제 operational deploy된 전력에서 PUE를 차감해 IT load를 산출.
formula_assumptions.source_ids: SRC_MCKINSEY_AI_WORKLOADS; SRC_EPRI_EPOCH_AI_POWER; SRC_EIA_DC_POWER; SRC_FERC_INTERCONNECT; SRC_UPTIME_GLOBAL_DC; SRC_ASHRAE_TC99

formula_assumptions.meaning_kr: active capacity가 전부 LLM 계산으로 쓰이지 않으므로 데이터센터 IT load 중 modeled model-owner AI training/serving 몫만 분리합니다. 업체별 dedicated AI 방향은 공식 source로 확인하되, 구체적 share는 telemetry 부재 시 scenario입니다.

formula_assumptions.formula: inference_gw = ai_it_load_gw * inference_power_share; training_gw = ai_it_load_gw * (1 - inference_power_share)
formula_assumptions.meaning_kr: inference 비중은 company fact가 아니라 상용화 성숙도와 제품 표면에 따른 시나리오 변수.
H200/B200/GB200/purpose-built 구성비를 직접 입력하여 같은 inference MW라도 fleet 구성에 따라 public reference TPS/MW가 달라지게 합니다. Purpose-built는 comparable benchmark가 없으면 B200 placeholder를 사용하며 editable input으로 남깁니다.
formula_assumptions.source_ids: SRC_MS_MAIA200; SRC_GOOGLE_IRONWOOD; SRC_GOOGLE_TPU_V6E; SRC_META_MTIA_GENAI_2026; SRC_AWS_RAINIER_ACTIVE; SRC_MLPERF_INFERENCE; SRC_MLPERF_POWER; SRC_TENSORRT_LLM; ASSUMP_NUMERIC_ACCELERATOR_MIX

formula_assumptions.formula: gpu_workload_avg_tps_mw = short_share*gpu_short_tps_mw + long_share*gpu_long_tps_mw + agentic_share*gpu_agentic_tps_mw; fleet_reference_tps_per_mw = sum(gpu_share*gpu_workload_avg_tps_mw); reference_serving_tps_per_mw = fleet_reference_tps_per_mw * commercial_workload_fit_factor
formula_assumptions.meaning_kr: InferenceX generated-output TPS/MW를 GPU별 short chat, long chat, agentic workload로 분리한 뒤 업체별 traffic/product mix로 먼저 가중합니다. 이후 H200/B200/GB200/purpose-built fleet mix를 적용합니다. Agentic은 Kimi K2.5 dynamic reasoning rows에서 산출한 agentic/long ratio를 long-context row에 적용합니다.
formula_assumptions.source_ids: SRC_SEMIANALYSIS_INFERENCEX; SRC_INFERENCEX_AGENTIC_TRACES_256K; SRC_ANTHROPIC_CONSUMPTION_GUIDE; SRC_OPENAI_CODEX_RATE_CARD; SRC_GOOGLE_GEMINI_LONG_CONTEXT; SRC_META_BUSINESS_AGENT; ASSUMP_NUMERIC_ACCELERATOR_MIX; ASSUMP_WORKLOAD_CLASS_MIX; ASSUMP_AGENTIC_CONTEXT_PENALTY

formula_assumptions.formula: inference_tokens_per_day = contracted_power_gw * operational_deployment_share / pue * ai_workload_share * inference_power_share * 1,000 * weighted_tps_per_mw * 86,400
formula_assumptions.meaning_kr: 최종 생성 토큰 capacity는 공개 또는 명시적 capacity envelope, 운영 투입 비율, PUE, AI/inference 배분, 선택 benchmark TPS/MW만으로 계산합니다.

formula_assumptions.category: Excluded from headline - operational serving sensitivities
formula_assumptions.formula: utilization, MoE uplift, architecture multiplier and software CAGR = sensitivity/reference only
formula_assumptions.meaning_kr: 이 항목들은 중요한 연구 주제이지만 업체별 production telemetry가 부족합니다. 동일한 효과를 TPS/MW와 다시 곱해 과도한 정밀도를 만들지 않기 위해 headline token 생성량에서는 제외합니다.
formula_assumptions.source_ids: SRC_ARXIV_SLO_PD_2026; SRC_IBM_PD_DISAGG_2026; SRC_VLLM_DOCS; SRC_SGLANG_DOCS; SRC_SARATHI_SERVE; SRC_ORCA_SERVING; SRC_SEMIANALYSIS_INFERENCEX

short_chat.label: Short chat / routine assistant
short_chat.rationale: Uses ISL/OSL 1024/1024 and concurrency 32-256 to avoid singleton and saturation extremes while representing short interactive chat/API output.

long_chat.label: Long chat / research / RAG
long_chat.rationale: Uses ISL/OSL 8192/1024 and concurrency 32-256 where available; otherwise applies an explicit placeholder or long-context haircut. Google long-context docs support treating this as a distinct workload class.

agentic.label: Agentic coding / tool workflow
agentic.interactivity_profile: agentic/tool workflow derived from Kimi K2.5 dynamic reasoning
agentic.rationale: Agentic trace profile averages about 100,947 input and 860 output tokens/request. Because InferenceX does not yet provide matched 100k-input benchmark rows, agentic TPS/MW is modeled as long_chat TPS/MW multiplied by the Kimi K2.5 dynamic-reasoning agentic/long ratio (10.9%).

workload_mix_profiles.rationale: Microsoft has broad Copilot surfaces plus GitHub/Codex-style developer workflows; agentic share is material but not dominant.
Gemini emphasizes long-context and enterprise agent platforms, but broad Workspace/Search-style assistant use remains large.
Meta AI and Business Agent are high-volume messaging/customer-service surfaces; agentic enterprise actions are emerging but smaller in Base.
Grok is modeled as interactive plus reasoning/search-style use; coding-agent share is not as directly evidenced as Anthropic/OpenAI.
ChatGPT remains broad short-chat/API, while Codex token-based pricing and ChatGPT agentic features support a large agentic slice.
Claude Enterprise guidance explicitly says Claude Code and Cowork are significantly more token-intensive than chat; Claude Code usage evidence supports the highest agentic mix.
DeepSeek R1/V3 traffic is modeled as reasoning/API-heavy with meaningful long-context and developer use, but no direct enterprise-agent surface disclosure.
Qwen/Model Studio is enterprise/API-heavy; long/reasoning use is meaningful while broad cloud assistant traffic keeps short chat substantial.
Hunyuan/Yuanbao and WeChat/Tencent Cloud surfaces are modeled as consumer/business chat-heavy; agentic action use is emerging but lower in Base.

commercial_workload_benchmarks.rationale: Copilot traffic mixes routed proprietary models and interactive SLOs; GPT-OSS is a reference ceiling, not direct telemetry. Workload mix: Microsoft has broad Copilot surfaces plus GitHub/Codex-style developer workflows; agentic share is material but not dominant.

Gemini serving is closed and TPU-heavy with product and multimodal routing; the DeepSeek V4 Pro + Kimi K2.5 frontier composite is used only as a public proxy, not production telemetry. Workload mix: Gemini emphasizes long-context and enterprise agent platforms, but broad Workspace/Search-style assistant use remains large.

Llama benchmark family is comparatively close to Meta AI serving, while fleet routing and MTIA performance remain unmeasured. Workload mix: Meta AI and Business Agent are high-volume messaging/customer-service surfaces; agentic enterprise actions are emerging but smaller in Base.

Grok is closed and reasoning/product workload mix is not matched to the GPT-OSS benchmark row. Workload mix: Grok is modeled as interactive plus reasoning/search-style use; coding-agent share is not as directly evidenced as Anthropic/OpenAI.

commercial_workload_benchmarks.commercial_workload_class: GPT / ChatGPT / API with reasoning mix
commercial_workload_benchmarks.rationale: ChatGPT/API demand includes reasoning and latency-sensitive surfaces; the DeepSeek V4 Pro + Kimi K2.5 frontier composite is not GPT production telemetry. Workload mix: ChatGPT remains broad short-chat/API, while Codex token-based pricing and ChatGPT agentic features support a large agentic slice.

commercial_workload_benchmarks.commercial_workload_class: Claude coding, agent and long-context enterprise
commercial_workload_benchmarks.rationale: Claude usage is materially coding/agent/long-context oriented; the DeepSeek V4 Pro + Kimi K2.5 frontier composite is used because comparable Claude production serving rows are not public. Workload mix: Claude Enterprise guidance explicitly says Claude Code and Cowork are significantly more token-intensive than chat; Claude Code usage evidence supports the highest agentic mix.

commercial_workload_benchmarks.commercial_workload_class: DeepSeek R1/V3 MoE with reasoning mix
commercial_workload_benchmarks.rationale: DeepSeek benchmark family is matched, but commercial R1 reasoning traffic can consume more serving capacity than a fixed test. Workload mix: DeepSeek R1/V3 traffic is modeled as reasoning/API-heavy with meaningful long-context and developer use, but no direct enterprise-agent surface disclosure.

Qwen benchmark family is relatively direct; remaining adjustment represents commercial context and SLO mix. Workload mix: Qwen/Model Studio is enterprise/API-heavy; long/reasoning use is meaningful while broad cloud assistant traffic keeps short chat substantial.

Hunyuan is not represented by a matched public TPS/MW row; GPT-OSS is used only as a reference ceiling. Workload mix: Hunyuan/Yuanbao and WeChat/Tencent Cloud surfaces are modeled as consumer/business chat-heavy; agentic action use is emerging but lower in Base.

model_checks.closed_parameter_precision: PASS - closed model rows use bands/undisclosed labels, not single precise parameter values.
model_checks.moe_total_active: PASS - DeepSeek and Alibaba rows include total and active parameter bands.
model_checks.microsoft_openai_overlap: PASS - attribution rule separates OpenAI model-owner output and Microsoft customer-facing serving.
model_checks.anthropic_scope: PASS - Anthropic is included as a core model-owner row; AWS/Google host capacity is attributed to Anthropic model output.
model_checks.benchmark_layer: PASS - GPU/effective-active-parameter benchmark reference is separated from the main tokens/sec/MW forecast.
model_checks.energy_sanity_layer: PASS - Joule/IBM/2026 serving sources are separated as sanity/sensitivity layers, not Base production telemetry.
model_checks.simple_headline_formula: PASS - headline output tokens use operational inference GW and workload-adjusted serving reference TPS/MW only; no utilization/MoE/software/architecture multiplier is applied.
model_checks.utilization_slo_layer: PASS - SLO/workload utilization remains supplemental sensitivity only and is not multiplied into headline output.
model_checks.numeric_accelerator_mix_bridge: PASS - H200/B200/GB200/purpose-built shares sum to 100%; fleet-weighted reference is explicit and purpose-built TPS/MW receives no unsupported uplift.
model_checks.workload_mix_bridge: PASS - short conversation, long conversation and agentic workload shares sum to 100%; GPU-level workload-weighted TPS/MW reconstructs headline TPS/MW.
model_checks.complete_numeric_trace_inputs: PASS - operational deployment, GPU-generation mix, workload mix, public TPS/MW reference, commercial workload fit and annual output tokens are formula-reconstructable.
model_checks.source_assumption_registry: PASS - Every source_id and assumption_id referenced by facts, formulas and forecast trace rows is registered.
model_checks.fact_vs_assumption_audit: PASS - Each company has nine input/output audit rows separating public anchors from modeled values.
